Description
When an HTTP profile and an iRule containing the PSC::ip_address command are configured on a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate and may lead to remote code execution (RCE).

Impact
Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system and may allow the attacker to perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

The Link Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'linkfile[name]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.10.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have enabled the "Link File" option within the plugin's settings, which activates the vulnerable file upload field on the public add-link form.

The Groundhogg plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' merge-tag of the [ghr] shortcode in versions up to, and including, 4.10 The post_title replacement is registered with 'nested' => true, so the nested branch of Replacements::do_replacement() returns the merge value through tackle_replacements() without passing it through escape_merge_tags()/escape_shortcodes(); the callback single_post() calls html_entity_decode(get_the_title(), ENT_QUOTES), converting the entity-encoded text that wp_filter_kses leaves intact on a Contributor's post title back into raw HTML, which is then emitted into the rendered post. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The User Frontend – Membership, User Registration, User Profile, User Directory & Content Restriction with Frontend Post Submission plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.14 via the `draft_post()` function. This is due to the function storing the `post_content` parameter via `wp_insert_post()` without the protected-shortcode allow-list check that was introduced in 4.3.14 for the sibling `submit_post()` handler — a gap that `wp_kses` filtering does not close, as it strips only HTML tags while leaving shortcode text such as `[wpuf-registration role="editor"]` intact. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to embed a registration shortcode in a post and cause any site visitor who subsequently registers through the rendered form to receive Editor-level access. The render-time `wpuf_modify_shortcodes` filter that is designed to neutralize protected shortcodes provides no protection here because posts created via the `wpuf_draft_post` AJAX endpoint carry no `_edit_last` post meta, causing the filter to return the content unchanged and allowing the shortcode to render and execute

The Kirki - Freeform Page Builder, Website Builder & Customizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Unauthorized Data Access in versions up to, and including, 6.4.1 via the `kirki_post_apis` AJAX action's `get-dynamic-content-batch` and `get-collection-batch` endpoints. This is due to the plugin opening these resolvers behind a site-wide, resource-unbound preview token (`EditorPreview::has_valid_token()`) that is NOT bound to the specific page the administrator intended to share, combined with the absence of any `list_users` or `can_user_read_post()` capability check inside `HelperFunctions::get_user_dynamic_content()` and `Collection::get_collection_batch()` — the equivalent checks ARE present on the plugin's own REST route (`FrontendRESTController::get_item_permissions_check()`). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers holding any valid read-only share link to extract from the entire user table every user's `user_email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `nickname`, `registered_date`, arbitrary string-valued `user_meta` (including custom keys such as `billing_phone`), and the e-mail address of every approved commenter — information that WordPress itself withholds from ano

The Dokan: AI Powered WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace Solution – Build Your Own Amazon, eBay, Etsy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3. The vulnerability exists because the `matches_mcp_endpoint()` function applies an unanchored regular expression (`#/(?:woocommerce|dokan)/mcp(?:/|$)#`) against the entire `REQUEST_URI` including the query string, meaning any request that contains the literal substring `/dokan/mcp/` or `/woocommerce/mcp/` anywhere in its URI — including inside a query parameter value — is incorrectly treated as a trusted internal MCP context, causing `scope_product_permissions()` to unconditionally return `true` on WooCommerce's `woocommerce_rest_check_permissions` filter regardless of whether the caller is authenticated. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read full authenticated WooCommerce REST product records for any published product — including private underscore-prefixed meta, purchase notes, downloadable file URLs for paid digital products, catalog-hidden products, and edit-context representations — across the `/wc/v1`, `/wc/v2`, `/wc/v3`, and `/wc-analytics` REST name

The HTML Forms – Simple WordPress Forms Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'arbitrary POST parameter NAME (the array key, not the value)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Script execution does not require the Screen Options panel to be opened — injected attributes on the hidden-column checkboxes fire on page load as soon as the Submissions tab is rendered.

An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the application.

When using the listen directive with the ssl parameter in the http block with TLSv1.3 enabled, an attacker can use a specially crafted TLS connection to cause an infinite loop in the NGINX worker process while reading the HTTP request body. As a result, the worker process stops accepting new connections and processing existing connections. Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Impact: This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of NGINX. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

Winmate HotTab Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Winmate devices. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HotTab driver. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel. Was ZDI-CAN-29948.

The Toolbox for Asgaros Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the replace_temp_pics function in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.4. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is only reachable when the site administrator has enabled the Inline Image Upload feature (disabled by default).

The DataPress (Dataverse Integration) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 2.97 via the 'src' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Exploitation requires WP_DEBUG to be defined as true on the target site — not the default on production, but commonly enabled on staging, development, and misconfigured production environments.

Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. If Apache Iggy 0.9.0 started without IGGY_ROOT_USERNAME and IGGY_ROOT_PASSWORD, it generated a root password and wrote it to the server log file, which is enabled by default. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) let a user with only the read_servers permission download the server log files. That user could read the generated root password and log in as root.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Version 0.10.0 never generates a root password, and the snapshot requires the manage_servers permission. If a 0.9.0 server generated its root password, change that password.

The JobBoardWP – Job Board Listings and Submissions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'job_description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin's default public submission workflow auto-provisions a jb_employer account for any visitor, meaning the effective entry point is unauthenticated — the custom role requirement imposes no real barrier on a stock install.

A Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information (CWE-319) vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. A man-in-the-middle attacker may be able to tamper with data transmitted between the application and the server, resulting in the display of modified content to users.

Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Publishing feature. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote unauthenticated attacker who can access a site published using the product may obtain, by sending a specially crafted request, information on records of unpublished sites (e.g., titles), as well as the names of users, groups, and organizations registered in the same tenant. Note that the vulnerability only affects configurations where both of the following conditions are met: a site is published using the Publishing feature, and the published site contains link items (items linked to other sites, users, groups, or organizations).

The Dynific Addons for Elementor (formerly Anywhere Elementor) WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not perform a capability check on an AJAX action that stores a configuration value, allowing any authenticated user, including Subscribers, to store a value that is later output without proper escaping in a quoted attribute on an administrator settings page, resulting in Stored Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the administrator's session.

The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not sanitise post meta saved through an AJAX action, nor escape it when rendering the product page, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor (who lack the unfiltered_html capability) to store JavaScript that executes in the browser of anyone who views the product, including administrators.

The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not verify that the acting user is authorised to modify the target post when saving a template, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to overwrite the content and type of an arbitrary post, including another user's published page, removing it from the front end.

The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not perform a capability or nonce check on an AJAX action available to authenticated users, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to disclose the name and content of non-public templates stored on the site.

Description:

When an iRule that processes client traffic using the GENERICMESSAGE::route command is configured on a virtual server, undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate and may lead to remote code execution (RCE). 





Impact:



Traffic is disrupted while the TMM process restarts. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the BIG-IP system and may allow the attacker to perform RCE. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.







Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

The The GDPR Framework By Data443 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.2. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete all postmeta rows for every Easy Digital Downloads payment order on the site, destroying order metadata belonging to all customers. Exploitation requires that Easy Digital Downloads 2.x is active and the GDPR Framework's EDD compatibility option is enabled with a delete or delete_and_notify action configured.

The Advanced Country Blocker plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected script is stored via the advcb_live_activity transient on the init hook and executed when an administrator views the Live Monitor page, as the stored URI is unsafely concatenated into a double-quoted HTML title attribute and inserted into the DOM via jQuery .html().

An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private repositories within the trusted certificate authority's scope. Exploitation required an instance using built-in authentication and a valid certificate issued to the attacker by a trusted SSH certificate authority. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

A site administrator could modify files on the appliance host with root privileges and disclose private repository data due to improper path validation in GitHub Enterprise Server. Exploitation required a crafted pre-receive hook environment. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

The Jeg Kit for Elementor – Powerful Addons for Elementor, Widgets & Templates for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful execution requires a published page containing both a Post Author widget in user_bio mode (rendering the attacker's biography) and any legitimate jkit_client_logo widget, so that client-logo.js is enqueued and the loadCarousel handler fires against the forged widget markup from the bio field.

The Custom Twitter Feeds – A Tweets Widget or X Feed Widget plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'atts (JSON object, specifically the inner `feed` key)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is first stored in the wp_ctf_feed_caches database table and later written into the ctf_cron_report WordPress option by the scheduled ctf_feed_update cron job, meaning execution is deferred until the cron runs and an administrator subsequently loads the Support page.

The Check & Log Email – Easy Email Testing & Mail logging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to approve the comment carrying the shortcode payload, and the target page must render the core Latest Comments block, which passes comment author names through do_shortcode via the_content.

The Geo Mashup plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author (comment form) / display_name (profile form)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.13.23 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The comment-author path requires the crafted comment to be approved before the payload is served to visitors; the subscriber-level path requires the plugin's user-location mapping feature to be enabled.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a local privilege-escalation vulnerability that could allow a low-privileged attacker to execute code as root on the NAS node.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds memory vulnerability in the NAS NFS service that an unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit to cause a denial of service.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the NAS TFTP service that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to cause a denial of service or potential code execution.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an authentication-bypass-by-replay vulnerability in the NAS NDMP service that could allow a network attacker to gain backup and restore control of the appliance.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the storage-processor interconnect driver that could allow a malicious peer to execute code with system privileges.

The FS Poster - WordPress Social media Auto Poster & Scheduler [Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Pinterest] plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to missing authorization to Unauthorized Social App Data Modification in all versions up to, and including, 8.0.1 This is due to missing authentication, nonce, and capability checks in the `standardFSApp()` function, which is registered on the `wp` action hook and executes on every frontend page load without any login or permission verification. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to insert arbitrary social network app records into the database, or overwrite the OAuth `client_id` and `client_secret` of existing social network connections, by supplying attacker-controlled values via the `fsp_app_redirect` and `app` GET parameters. An attacker can target a specific existing social app record for credential overwrite by supplying matching `social_network` and `slug` values, requiring no knowledge of internal record IDs, which disrupts scheduled social media posts and forces administrators to re-authenticate their connected accounts.

The Multi Step for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 2.9.1 via the '_cf7mls_db_form_data_id' parameter due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to permanently delete arbitrary stored Contact Form 7 submissions from the database. Exploitation requires the companion CF7 Database plugin to be active and the per-form "Save every step, not just the final submission" option to be enabled.

The rus to lat advanced plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to blind SQL Injection via the 'name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The Kirki – Freeform Page Builder, Website Builder & Customizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment (title attribute of <abbr>)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.4.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to run the Kirki Convert (migration) workflow on a page containing the attacker's approved comment, as the browser-side DOM parser decodes the kses-allowed abbr title attribute value into a raw XSS payload that is then persisted without sanitization and later rendered unescaped. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

In specific versions of Octopus Tentacle, Tentacle fails to unset registration credentials as environment variables, resulting in deployment scripts potentially having the ability to read those credentials.

Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command ('OS command injection') vulnerability in Aidata Bilişim Kurumsal Tic. Ve San. A.Ş. Aidata WR854GVR allows OS Command Injection.

This issue affects Aidata WR854GVR: before V4.0.18_261111.

A low-privileged remote attacker can change the password of arbitrary users using the REST API, including administrative accounts. By changing the administrator password, an attacker can obtain full administrative access to the device and modify all configuration settings.

When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured as a mail proxy, undisclosed traffic can cause a use-after-free in an nginx worker process. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
A remote unauthenticated attacker may crash an nginx worker process or corrupt its memory, disrupting service. Remote code execution is a potential impact. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.



Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

A command injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated site administrator to execute arbitrary commands as the host git user on peer Git server nodes outside the pre-receive hook sandbox by supplying a crafted pre-receive environment download URL. Exploitation required a clustered deployment using custom pre-receive hook environments and at least one peer Git server node. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, 3.20.12, and 3.19.16. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

Out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the pixReadMemJp2kCore() function in Leptonica, located in jp2kio.c. The function retrieves the output dimensions only for component 0 and uses a common index to iterate through the buffers of all components. If the remaining components have smaller dimensions, the traversal exceeds the bounds of their sample buffers, which are allocated by OpenJPEG. When processing a specially crafted JPEG 2000 image, data read from adjacent dynamic memory may be incorporated into the pixels of the decoded image and result in information disclosure to anyone who can access the output.

In PcVue version 17.0.0 through 17.0.1 included, user account security settings could be modified. 
This could lead to unauthorized modification of password
policies or other security-related account settings by privileged users. 
The
update aligns user account management with the existing security-altering
enforcement model and prevents unauthorized security configuration changes.

The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'code' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload persists through WooCommerce session data into order-item metadata and executes when rendered in the ticket scanner interface.

An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from private repositories they could not access. An attacker required an authenticated account, a readable repository and pull request to use as the request context, and target review-thread identifiers. The thread-preview endpoint resolved supplied identifiers without restricting them to the authorized pull request, exposing private file paths and, when positioning and diff data were available, source-code excerpts, commit identifiers, and line metadata without victim interaction. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.21, 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.21.10, 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.
Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.
Dell PowerStore contains an authorization bypass vulnerability. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to act under another user's session, potentially leading to denial of service.

The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content/excerpt (REST wp/v2/posts) → stored in post_content/post_excerpt' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor's entity-encoded payload survives save-time wp_kses filtering verbatim and is only decoded into raw script tags at render time via html_entity_decode(), meaning the injected script executes for every visitor — including authenticated Administrators — once an Editor publishes the post through the standard Contributor workflow.

The Trust Payments Gateway for WooCommerce (JavaScript Library) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.8. The vulnerability exists because the `new_customer_account()` function stores the raw return value of `wp_create_user()` — including a `WP_Error` object returned on username collision — into the order's `tp_userid` post meta before the `is_wp_error()` guard is evaluated; the `add_customer_details_to_thankyou_page()` callback subsequently reads that meta and casts it with `(int)`, causing PHP to coerce any object to integer `1`, after which `wp_set_current_user(1)` and `wp_set_auth_cookie(1)` are called unconditionally. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as WordPress user ID 1 — the bootstrap site administrator or, on multisite, a network super-admin — by supplying the `new_username` parameter matching any existing login during checkout and visiting the resulting thank-you page. Exploitation requires the Trust Payments gateway to be active and the attacker to complete a paid order on their own account; the ID 1 administrator username is additionally enumerable via standard WordPress

Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID. After an administrator deleted a user, that user's unexpired token, or a token refreshed from it while the ID was free, authenticated as the next account created with that ID and had that account's permissions. Only deployments with HTTP enabled are affected.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: through 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

The Unzer Payments plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass leading to Account Takeover in all versions up to, and including, 2.2.1. The vulnerability exists because the Google Pay Express Checkout endpoint (`/?wc-api=google_pay_express`), handled by `startCheckoutDataWithNormalizedCustomerData`, accepts an attacker-controlled `paymentData.email` value and passes it to `createOrGetGuestCustomer()`, which resolves the submitted email to any existing WordPress user via `get_user_by('email', ...)` and then calls `wp_set_current_user()` and `wp_set_auth_cookie()` for the resolved user ID without verifying ownership of the email address, a password, a nonce, an authentication token, or any proof of payment from the payment provider. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to log in as any existing WordPress user — including administrators — by submitting that user's known email address, receiving valid `wordpress_logged_in_*` session cookies for the targeted account and achieving full site takeover. The endpoint is entirely unprotected with no capability check, nonce validation, or payment-provider signature verification applied, and administrator email a

A out of bounds read after using negative integers during offset calculation during PCF decoding in X.Org libXfont before 2.0.10 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash the X server or expose sensitive information in its memory.
A heap buffer overflow in reading encoding files in X.Org libfontenc before 1.11.0 could be used by local attackers able to inject enc files to the X server could crash or escalate privileges.

CAST Imaging has an access control flaw in the "/api/jobs/<uuid>/logs/download" endpoint. An authenticated low-privilege user can download log archives for any job whose UUID they know, even if they are not authorized to access it.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging allows authenticated, low-privileged users to access parts of the administrator panel. When a user navigates to any URL path the application doesn't recognize, a wildcard route automatically redirects them to the administrative view at "/admin/applications". This allows an attacker to perform certain administrator-restricted actions, including triggering app-to-app link generation, configuring regexes, and changing searchable object properties, resulting in unauthorized modification of application configuration.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging does not properly check whether a user is authorized to modify another user's notification settings in the "/api/admin/user/update-subscriber" endpoint. An authenticated, low-privileged attacker can enable or disable email notifications on another user's behalf, which can suppress important communications such as security alerts and disrupt business processes.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging contains a hardcoded authentication token in the "KeyCloakController" class of auth-service.jar. An attacker who gains access to the source code, application package, logs, or configuration files can reuse this token to call auth-service endpoints without authentication. Using the token with the "/api/auth/keycloak/users" endpoint, the attacker can enumerate users across Keycloak realms and retrieve user attributes containing API token hashes, enabling reconnaissance and further exploitation.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging is vulnerable to Path Traversal vulnerability in "/api/server-folders" and "/api/server-folders/download" endpoints. These file-management endpoints accept user-supplied filesystem paths and allow selected system commands to be executed at the specified location, but they do not enforce sufficient authorization boundaries or restrict access to a predefined set of resources. An authenticated attacker can enumerate server directories via the "ls" command and retrieve arbitrary files outside of the intended application workspace, such as "/etc/passwd", exposing sensitive data.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify the email address of an arbitrary Keycloak user and access sensitive account information, including the API authentication token hash. This can lead to account takeover, user impersonation and user enumeration.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging has multiple path traversal vulnerabilities in various endpoints. The application does not properly validate the path parameters, allowing an authenticated attacker to use "../" sequences to escape the intended directory and read arbitrary files.


Critically, by reading "/proc/self/environ", the attacker can obtain environment variables containing sensitive credentials such as Keycloak and PostgreSQL passwords, leading to full server compromise and administrative access.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

CAST Imaging is vulnerable to authentication bypass in the TenantFilter class. The TenantFilter processes the X-ISSUER-LOCATION HTTP header and dynamically registers an OpenID Connect issuer based on its value. An unauthenticated remote attacker can register a malicious identity provider, create users matching existing administrative usernames, and obtain valid JWTs which will be accepted by the application. This results in complete authentication bypass and privilege escalation to administrative access.




The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

The WP Maps – Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Mapbox, Store Locator with Search, Filters & Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'csv_columns' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to second-order SQL Injection via the user profile description field in all Free versions up to, and including, 1.26.15 and all Premium versions up to, and including, 2.26.15. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to store a malicious payload that is written into a database backup and executed as SQL when an administrator later restores that backup. Successful exploitation can modify sensitive WordPress data and, on sites where plugin installation is available, lead to remote code execution through the installation and activation of an attacker-controlled plugin.
Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed a time-of-check time-of-use race condition vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an information disclosure vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.

The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not restrict one of its database tools to network administrators on multisite installations, allowing administrators of a single subsite to run arbitrary SQL against the whole network's database and make themselves Super Admin.

The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not correctly restrict which database tables an administrator of a single site may operate on in a multisite network, allowing subsite administrators to read and modify the tables of other sites and of the network, and to make themselves Super Admin.

The Bizuno Accounting – ERP/Accounting/CRM (for WordPress) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Password Reset Token Disclosure in all versions up to, and including, 7.4.5 via the `bizUser` parameter of the `validateReset()` function on the `portal/api/lostPW` endpoint. This is due to `portalCtl::goAPI()` failing to call `loadBusinessCache()` before invoking the handler, which causes `isMailConfigured()` to read an empty business cache and return false regardless of the site's actual mail configuration, causing the fully-qualified reset URL — containing the victim's live reset UUID and numeric user ID — to be embedded directly in the HTML response rather than delivered by email. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to obtain a valid password-reset token for any Bizuno account, including administrators, directly from the HTTP response and submit it to the `portal/api/lostVal` endpoint to rewrite the victim's password and achieve full account takeover. The administrator email address required to initiate the reset is frequently exposed by the plugin's own login error messages and the public `/bizuno/` portal page, making exploitation trivial
Dell PowerStore contains an integer underflow vulnerability. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to denial of service of a cryptographic service.

Dell PowerStore contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability to make the appliance connect to attacker-chosen internal systems.

Dell PowerStore contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. A low-privileged authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to execution of malicious script in a higher-privileged user's session.

Dell PowerStore contains an OS command injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to arbitrary command execution with root privileges.
Dell PowerStore contains an Improper Privilege Management vulnerability. An authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to administrator.
Dell PowerStore contains a CSV Injection vulnerability. A high-privileged attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to code execution on another user's workstation.

The Royal Addons for Elementor  WordPress plugin before 1.7.1071 does not restrict or validate the post meta keys used when counting or rendering a filtered grid, and does not reject private (hidden) meta keys, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the value of arbitrary private post meta one value at a time from the filtered result count. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-17585, whose 1.7.1067 patch covered only a separate search-based path and left the grid filtering path affected.

A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

The Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.3.90. This is due to a nonce-only settings AJAX handler that stores an attribute-breaking value and an administrator settings template that outputs it without HTML attribute escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The Envira Gallery  WordPress plugin before 1.16.4 does not apply its own gallery-permission policy until an administrator first opens its permissions screen, instead copying gallery-management capabilities onto each role from that role's core post capabilities after activation, which lets Contributor accounts create, edit and delete galleries that the policy is meant to restrict to higher roles.

Multiple ELECOM wireless LAN routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that may cause an arbitrary OS command to be executed by an attacker who can access the administrative interface of the affected product.

The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit succeeds even though wp_kses is applied on save, because the XSS is manufactured post-sanitization by the plugin's regex pass: kses-permitted tags such as <a title> and <code> carry the attacker's marker and terminator strings intact into the rendered HTML buffer, where the plugin's own replacement then corrupts the document structure.

The ownCloud Desktop Client synchronizes files between an ownCloud server and a desktop. Prior to 6.0.2, an authenticated attacker can share a specially crafted file with a victim. If the file is synced by the client and revealed in the macOS Finder, it can cause operating-system command injection on the victim’s computer. This issue is fixed in version 6.0.2.

A post-authenticated external control of system web interface configuration setting vulnerability exists in the Danfoss AK-SM8xxA Series prior to version 4.3.1, which could allow for a denial-of-service attack induced by improper handling of exceptional conditions.

vulnerabilities.description: Improper neutralization of alarm-to-mail configuration fields used in an OS shell command injection in Danfoss AK-SM8xxA Series, prior to version 4.3.1, may lead to post-authenticated remote code execution on an attacked system.
vulnerabilities.action: Users can obtain and install the latest version by following the AK-SM 800A Software Upgrade Process.

remediation.details: Users can obtain and install the latest version by following the AK-SM 800A Software Upgrade Process.

vulnerabilities.description: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in OpenText™ Connected MX allows Privilege Escalation. The vulnerability could allow a local, low-privileged user of a macOS endpoint to gain root privileges through the Connected MX Agent update process. This issue affects Connected MX macOS Agent: before 25.2.

An incorrect implementation of authentication algorithm vulnerability in the SSO API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.2.2-72806-5 and 7.3.1-86003-1 (7.2.1-69057 is not affected) allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks with prior knowledge of the distinguished name (DN).

Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

Bagisto 2.1.0 before 2.2.1 contains a client-side template injection vulnerability in the search page where the 'query' parameter is rendered unescaped inside a Vue app root. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted VueJS template expressions to the /bagisto-common/search endpoint via the 'query' parameter to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

The PDMS/E3D Engineering Interface improperly handles XML External Entity (XXE) entries when communicating with an external application. vulnerabilities.description: iDocView before 13.10.1_20231115 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the /html/2word endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files by supplying a malicious url parameter. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the url parameter to download linked resources with an unsanitized path and unblocked .jsp extension, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-22.

LiveBOS builds through 2023-08-16 contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files via the imgName parameter in /feed/ShowImage.do using a ';.js.jsp' suffix bypass. Attackers can send crafted GET requests with directory traversal sequences in imgName to read system files such as /etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-30.

nginxWebUI 3.0.0 before 3.5.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach the /AdminPage/conf/runCmd endpoint by using a case-variant path that evades the case-sensitive /adminPage/ login filter. Attackers can pass OS commands through the cmd parameter, which are executed via /bin/sh with insufficient filtering of & and $() characters, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Nuxt 3.0.0-rc.1 before 3.0.0-rc.13 contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability caused by the Vite dev server default setting vite.server.fs.strict=false. Unauthenticated attackers can request /_nuxt/@fs/<absolute path> with a raw query to read arbitrary files like /etc/passwd from the system. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-18.

Nuxt 3.0.0 before 3.4.2 contains a semi-arbitrary file read vulnerability in the vite-node dev server middleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by supplying an absolute path as the moduleId. Attackers can send GET requests to /__nuxt_vite_node__/module/ with an absolute file path to read sensitive system files. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware 12.12 through 12.14, 15.5 before 18.10, 19.0 before 21.9, 22.0 before 24.3, and 25.0 contain a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the objectId parameter of tiki-ajax_services.php. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the comment controller and list action to execute arbitrary JavaScript and steal session tokens or credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

vulnerabilities.description: SLiMS Senayan Library Management System 9.4.0 before 9.4.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the destination parameter of /index.php?p=member, which is echoed unmodified into the login form action attribute. Unauthenticated attackers can craft a malicious destination value to inject script and hijack PHPSESSID sessions of victims who access the link. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Tangshan Pingsheng Reservoir Safety Supervision Platform builds through 2022-11-30 contain an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the simcardId parameter of /WebServices/SIMMaintainService.asmx/GetAllRechargeRecordsBySIMCardId. Attackers can send crafted POST requests with time-based MSSQL payloads to extract database information including user, version, and database name. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

JoomBri Careers 3.3.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the 'keyword' parameter of the /for-jobseekers/search-jobs endpoint in com_jbcareers. Attackers can craft malicious URLs using an attribute-breakout payload with onfocus and autofocus to execute arbitrary JavaScript and steal session tokens or credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Reddit Top RSS through commit 5e38bfd contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the unescaped score GET parameter. Attackers can craft links with a score value that closes the input value attribute in html.php, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

PMB 7.3.1 before 7.3.15 and 7.4.x before 7.4.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script through unescaped POST parameter names. Attackers can send crafted parameter names to opac_css/index.php extended_search, which empr.inc.php and languages.inc.php reflect into hidden form inputs to execute JavaScript. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

QiboCMS V7 contains an arbitrary file download vulnerability in inc/job/download.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by supplying a base64-encoded url parameter to /do/job.php?job=download. Attackers can bypass the .php extension check using the Windows 'ph<' wildcard to download sensitive files such as configuration files containing database credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-18.

Synway SMG Gateway Management Software builds through 2022-03-15 contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files via the downfile parameter in /down.php. Attackers can send a multipart POST request to /down.php with a traversal path in downfile to retrieve sensitive files like /etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

CmsEasy 7.7.5_20210919 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the execsql_action function at /?case=crossall&act=execsql that executes attacker-supplied queries decrypted with the hardcoded key 'cmseasy_sql'. Attackers can send a crafted 'sql' parameter to run arbitrary SQL and dump the admin username and password hash. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-22.

MeterSphere versions 1.13.0 before 1.14.7 and 1.15.0 before 1.16.4 contain a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability due to the /plugin/** endpoints being exposed with anonymous access. Attackers can upload a malicious jar via POST /plugin/add and invoke it through POST /plugin/customMethod using the 'entry' and 'request' parameters, which are passed to Class.forName and method invocation for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

The libexpat library is incorporated in the AFS, AFR and AFF products family. In versions of libexpat through 2.4.9, there is a use-after free caused by overeager destruction of a shared DTD in XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate in out-of-memory situations. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could lead to a denial-of-service condition.

vulnerabilities.description: Open Journal Systems 2.1.0 before 3.0.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external domains by abusing the source parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to /index.php/index/user/setLocale/<locale> with a source value beginning with '@', which UserHandler.inc.php appends to the server host, redirecting victims to attacker-controlled sites for phishing. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-12-05.

OTOBO 10.0.1 before 10.0.13 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying arbitrary URLs to the ExternalURLJump action. Attackers can craft GET requests to /otobo/index.pl?Action=ExternalURLJump with a malicious URL parameter, which the ExternalURLJump.pm module redirects to without an allow-list check, enabling phishing attacks. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Zhongqing Naboo Education Cloud Platform builds through 2021-07-09 contain a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/TeacherQuery/SearchTeacherInSiteWithPagerRecords endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive teacher data. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to this endpoint to retrieve user names, login names, and admin ids from the JSON response. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-15.

OpenSNS 3.2.1 contains an unauthenticated code injection vulnerability in the shareBox method of ShareController that allows attackers to invoke arbitrary model methods via the query parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to /index.php?s=weibo/Share/shareBox abusing parse_str and ShareModel::getInfo to reach Schedule::runSchedule and execute code through assert. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Weaver E-cology 9.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in /page/exportImport/uploadOperation.jsp that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary JSP files. Attackers can send a crafted multipart POST request with a JSP webshell written to /page/exportImport/fileTransfer/ to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

Chamilo LMS 1.11.10 before 1.11.16 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the searchOptionsFromTags function through the options parameter of extra_field.ajax.php. Attackers can send POST requests with a malicious JSON options array to inject SQL into the IN clause and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

vulnerabilities.description: Gnuboard5 5.0.1 before 5.3.3.3 and 5.4.0.1 before 5.4.0.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the arr_ajax_msg parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugin/sms5/ajax.sms_emoticon.php, where common.php's @extract($_GET) injects the value into the echoed JSON output, executing script in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

FineReport 8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files through the resourcepath parameter of the /WebReport/ReportServer endpoint. Attackers can send GET requests with op=chart and cmd=get_geo_json to read sensitive files like privilege.xml and extract admin credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

FineCMS versions 5.0.4 before 5.0.11 contain an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the data2 API action handled by list_tag in libraries/Template.php. Attackers can send GET requests to index.php?c=api&m=data2 with a valid auth hash and the param action=sql sql='...' to execute arbitrary SELECT queries and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Tiny Tiny RSS before commit c68ac04 (2019-03-03) contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users through the unvalidated 'return' parameter. Attackers can craft requests to /public.php?op=login with an absolute external URL in 'return', which is placed in the Location header to send victims to attacker-controlled sites. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-02-26.

ThinkPHP 5.0.0 before 5.0.24 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by setting _method=__construct in POST data to overwrite the Request filter property. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints reached via ?s=captcha or ?s=index/index/index with filter[]=system and server[REQUEST_METHOD] values to execute arbitrary system commands. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

vulnerabilities.description: NUUO NVRmini 2 through 3.0.8 contains a file disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read web-root files by passing a filename to the 'css' parameter of css_parser.php. Attackers can retrieve PHP source files confined to the document root, exposing hardcoded credentials and sensitive application logic. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

Lucee Server versions 5.0.0.0 before 5.3.4.46 contain an insecure default configuration that allows unauthenticated attackers to set the initial admin password via the first-run form on /lucee/admin/web.cfm and /lucee/admin/server.cfm. Attackers can access the 'New Password' set-password form before any password is configured to seize administrative control of the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-24.

ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

The ActiveBar ActiveX control distributed in ActBar.ocx 1.0.3.8 in SYS600 product does not properly restrict the SetLayoutData method, which could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted data argument.

vulnerabilities.description: Virtual Keyboard plugin for SquirrelMail through 0.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script by supplying unsanitized input in the passformname parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugins/vkeyboard/vkeyboard.php with script payloads in passformname to execute code in victims' browsers and steal session cookies. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Mistune is a Python Markdown parser with renderers and plugins. Prior to 3.3.4, inline image parsing sends nested ![ openers through precedence_scan because the no_link_before and _label_contains_link linearization guards are gated by not is_image. In src/mistune/inline_parser.py, each outer image opener can therefore search the remaining image body, while max_image_depth does not apply because the failed scans do not produce image tokens. Rendering untrusted Markdown with the default HTML renderer and no plugins can perform quadratic CPU work and keep a worker at 100 percent utilization. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.

Mistune is a Python Markdown parser with renderers and plugins. Prior to 3.3.4, parse_link_href performs an unbounded parenthesis-balancing scan to the end of the document for each unmatched opening parenthesis reached through an empty [] link label. In src/mistune/helpers.py and src/mistune/inline_parser.py, the empty label bypasses no_close_bracket_before, and no_link_before advances only past the short label, so successive [] ( candidates repeatedly scan the remaining document. Rendering untrusted Markdown with the default HTML renderer and no plugins can perform quadratic CPU work and keep a worker at 100 percent utilization. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.4.

vulnerabilities.description: Linkwarden is a self-hosted, open-source collaborative bookmark manager to collect, organize and archive webpages. Prior to 2.15.0, .github/workflows/check-branch.yml runs on the privileged pull_request_target event and interpolates the attacker-controlled github.head_ref source branch name unquoted into a run: shell script. An unauthenticated attacker can open a pull request from a fork with shell metacharacters in its branch name, causing arbitrary commands to execute in the base repository's privileged CI job before the branch comparison result matters. The job has access to GITHUB_TOKEN and any exposed secrets, allowing secret exfiltration and, when workflow token permissions allow repository writes, modification of repository content. This issue is fixed in version 2.15.0.

The SOCKS5 client in subsys/net/lib/socks/socks.c built the CONNECT request in socks5_tcp_connect() by choosing the SOCKS5 address type from the address family of the proxy (proxy->sa_family) while reading the bytes out of the destination address supplied to connect(). A SOCKS5 request encodes the destination independently of the transport used to reach the proxy, so the two families are unrelated and nothing in the path forces them to agree: set_context_proxy() only requires the proxy family to match the socket, and zsock_connect_ctx() enters the SOCKS branch before any destination validation. With an IPv6 proxy and an AF_INET destination the code treated an 8-byte struct net_sockaddr_in as a struct net_sockaddr_in6 and copied the 16-byte sin6_addr from it, reading 12 bytes past the end of the object and transmitting them to the proxy.

With CONFIG_USERSPACE enabled, z_vrfy_zsock_connect() copies only addrlen user bytes into a stack-resident struct net_sockaddr_storage and enforces no per-family minimum length, so the oversized read stays within the storage but returns stale, uninitialised kernel-stack bytes. vulnerabilities.description: A maliciously crafted DWG file, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD or processed by the installed DWG thumbnail handler, can force an Out-of-Bounds Write vulnerability resulting in heap corruption. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to cause a crash or execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process.

A maliciously crafted DXF file containing crafted VBA project data, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Out-of-Bounds Read vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to read sensitive data from process memory.

A maliciously crafted DWG or DXF file containing a crafted field format string, when parsed through Autodesk AutoCAD, can force an Out-of-Bounds Read vulnerability. A malicious actor can leverage this vulnerability to read sensitive data from process memory.

Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business. Prior to release.2026-07-17T05-20-38Z.2264, the routes for PluginService::regenerateSecret and PluginService::delete carry no @Permissions decorator, and the methods omit plugin ownership checks. An authenticated attacker can directly target another plugin's identifier to rotate and disclose its OAuth secret or delete the plugin, including system plugins. Separately, PermissionGuard authorizes several nested API requests using a caller-controlled parent tableId, baseId, or spaceId, while the services resolve the requested child object only by its globally unique identifier. An authenticated attacker can provide a parent resource the attacker owns together with a victim's child identifier. ViewService::getViewById can then disclose another tenant's view configuration, embedded filter values, field layout, and shareId. DashboardService::updatePluginStorage and the view-position updatePluginStorage path can overwrite another tenant's plugin storage because the plugin installation is not rebound to the authorized base, dashboard, table, or view. This issue is fixed in release.2026-07-17T05-20-38Z.2264.

code16 Sharp is a Laravel-based framework for building content-management and administrative interfaces. Prior to 9.23.0, an authenticated attacker can call the autocomplete API with a request endpoint that contains the configured remote endpoint only as a substring. The endpoint validation uses an unanchored regular expression, so a different internal route can satisfy the check and be invoked server-side through the autocomplete request. The vulnerable path uses SharpFormAutocompleteRemoteField::setRemoteEndpoint(); applications using SharpFormAutocompleteRemoteField::setRemoteCallback() are not affected by this endpoint-selection flaw. This issue is fixed in version 9.23.0.

code16 Sharp is a Laravel-based framework for building content-management and administrative interfaces. Prior to 9.23.0, an authenticated attacker can submit an arbitrary PHP class name through the embed_key parameter to multiple embed API endpoints. The application passes the selected class to the Laravel service container, which invokes the class's __construct() method and recursively instantiates constructor dependencies, potentially causing unauthorized integrity or availability effects. The attacker cannot supply constructor parameter values or invoke an arbitrary method. This issue is fixed in version 9.23.0.

Bludit through 3.22.0 contains an improper session invalidation vulnerability that allows demoted users to retain revoked privileges because Login::isLogged() never re-reads the session-stored role. Attackers holding a session issued while their account was an administrator can keep using it after demotion to perform administrator actions such as creating new administrator accounts.

Bludit through 3.22.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to modify the site logo by calling unprotected AJAX endpoints. Attackers with Author or Editor roles can send requests to logo-upload.php or logo-remove.php under /admin/ajax/ to replace the site logo with an uploaded image or delete it.

Under specific conditions, PingAuthorize in Gateway mode can continue an asynchronous upstream request after its 30-second gateway timeout. If the underlying keep-alive connection is reused for another request before the original response arrives, the late response can be written to the newer exchange. This could cause a subsequent caller to receive response data intended for an earlier request. This behaviour affects all releases and primarily risks unauthorized information disclosure between separate requests.

vulnerabilities.description: Kiwi TCMS is an open source test management system. From 16.1 until 16.2, the account confirmation page’s incomplete validation of the next parameter accepts protocol-relative URLs because the version 16.1 fix for CVE-2026-54724 only requires the value to start with a slash. An unauthenticated attacker can craft a confirmation URL on a trusted Kiwi TCMS hostname that redirects a user to an external site, enabling phishing and related downstream confidentiality or integrity impacts when the user follows the link. This issue is fixed in version 16.2.

Camunda 7.24.0 before 7.24.14 and 7.23.0 before 7.23.17 contains an XML External Entity (XXE) injection vulnerability in the camunda-external-task-client's DomXmlDataFormat.defaultDocumentBuilderFactory(), which fails to disable external entity resolution when parsing object variables serialized with application/xml. An attacker able to write a process variable can trigger arbitrary file read and out-of-band outbound HTTP requests from every worker JVM that deserializes the variable, enabling exfiltration of credentials, service-account tokens, and private key material from network segments deeper than the engine itself.

vulnerabilities.description: Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, check_client_auth() in src/api/auth.c detects that a matching session identifier has passed valid_until but still assigns user_id before the expired state can be rejected. That assignment sends execution through the authorized branch, renews valid_until for another timeout interval, and leaves the session-expired response unreachable. An attacker who possesses a previously valid session identifier can periodically reuse it to preserve administrative access indefinitely, making the configured session timeout ineffective. This issue is fixed in version 6.7.

vulnerabilities.description: Filament Curator is a media picker plugin for Filament panels. From 3.0.0 until 3.7.9, 4.1.2, and 5.1.2, the Curator media panel accepts image/svg+xml files by default and stores and serves their markup inline without sanitization. An authenticated user with media-upload permission can store an SVG containing scripts, event-handler attributes, or javascript: URIs. When another panel user selects the View action, the SVG opens as a top-level browser document and its active content executes in the Filament application's origin. The script can perform authenticated same-origin actions as the viewing user and read same-origin data and script-accessible tokens. Panel thumbnails are not affected because they render through an image element that does not execute SVG script. This issue is fixed in versions 3.7.9, 4.1.2, and 5.1.2.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, a user with backup-management permission can upload a crafted gzip-compressed tar archive through web/html/configuracao/importar_dump.php, after which web/controle/control.php accepts a user-controlled modulo value and combines it with nomeClasse for require_once(). By using a phar:// path to the uploaded archive and selecting the whitelisted InternoControle, whose empty resource list is treated as authorized, the user can cause an embedded controller file and its requested method to execute as the web-server process. The attack path depends on the configured BKP_DIR, and enabling phar.readonly or phar.require_hash does not prevent PHP from reading the gzip tar archive through phar://. Successful exploitation permits access to or modification of sensitive data, configuration, credentials, source files, host commands, and services reachable by the web-server account. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.9.1, web/controle/control.php authorizes FuncionarioControle requests only by checking whether an authenticated employee has a permission row for resource 11 or 91, while MiddlewareDAO::verificarPermissao() does not compare the stored id_acao value or authorize the requested method. An employee with any such permission and a valid CSRF token from the employee's own session can invoke FuncionarioControle::adicionarPermissao, FuncionarioControle::alterarPermissao, or FuncionarioControle::excluirPermissao to add, change, or remove permissions for arbitrary roles. This can grant higher action levels over sensitive resources, expose or modify protected employee, patient, configuration, and administrative data, or disrupt legitimate access by changing other roles. This issue is fixed in version 3.9.1.

Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. Prior to 0.40.3, unauthenticated requests to /bookmark can supply a url that server/src/plugins/bookmark.rs passes through fetch_data to fetch_body. Endpoint dispatch in lib/src/db.rs invokes the handler before check_read, and lib/src/client/helpers.rs previously checked only that the URL began with HTTP, without restricting loopback, private, link-local, DNS-rebinding, or redirect targets. The handler reflects fetched content in returned resource fields, making this a full-response server-side request forgery that can expose internal services and plain-GET cloud metadata. The short request timeout limits slow targets, and metadata services requiring a separate token request are outside the demonstrated GET-only path. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.29.0 to 0.40.2, Atomic Server provisions a well-known /setup invite with write enabled, the Drive root as its target, and usagesLeft set to one. construct_invite_redirect in server/src/plugins/invite.rs discards the redeemer identity, so an unauthenticated request containing an attacker-controlled public-key can create a new Agent and grant it write access to the entire Drive. On a fresh, unclaimed deployment, this permits reading, modifying, or deleting resources, changing permissions, and creating or altering Agents. No complete fixed version was verified as of this review.

Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.30.0 until 0.40.3, the Commit application path in lib/src/commit.rs allows an authenticated Agent to assign the server-managed internalId property to an owned resource without character validation. The /download handler in server/src/handlers/download.rs passes that value to filesystem path construction and NamedFile::open without sanitization, containment validation, or a File-class check, so traversal or absolute paths can read files available to the server process. Reading the server configuration can expose the root Agent private key and allow root impersonation with full read, write, and delete access to server data. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. From 0.30.0 until 0.40.3, an authenticated Agent with folder write access can use POST /upload to store HTML or SVG content that GET /download/{path} serves from the application origin through server/src/handlers/download.rs. The response sets Content-Disposition: inline and lacks forced attachment handling and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, allowing the browser to render the uploaded active content as the application. When a victim opens the link, the script can access the JavaScript-readable atomic_session cookie and the Agent private key in same-origin IndexedDB, enabling persistent account impersonation. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

Ikaros is a content management system for ACGMN media. Prior to 1.2.0, server/src/main/java/run/ikaros/server/core/tag/TagEndpoint.java does not enforce tag ownership for authenticated users with tag permissions. GET /tags/condition accepts an arbitrary userId and can enumerate another user's tags, DELETE /tag/id/{id} deletes a tag without comparing its owner to the requester, and DELETE /tag/condition omits userId from its filter and can delete every user's tags matching the supplied condition. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.0.

NVIDIA Model Optimizer for Linux and Windows contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a deserialization of untrusted data. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, data tampering, denial of service, and information disclosure.
